extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New: up to three rows of posters on Home. Home Row 1 to 3 on the Home Screen page, each Off by default, pick a source: recently added films or episodes, films or episodes in progress, unwatched films or shows, random films, or one of your lists. While any row is on the main menu sits at the top to make room and Menu Position is greyed out; with every row off Home is as it was. A row with nothing in it says so and the focus passes it by. Beside Engage's Coming Up list the rows run narrower, and under a top corner bar they start lower. Changed: Up and Down on Home now run top to bottom in one line through the menu, the rows, the caption buttons, the corner bar and the tabs.
